title: The Ruthless Lady Upholds Her Code of Honor
description:
Kokuryu, a living legend of the underworld, was a yakuza who never strayed from his code of honor, even among criminals. After losing his life in an unexpected accident, he awakens in the world of an otome game... where he has reincarnated as the villainess “Eliza Thiel,” whose execution is already a fixed fate...!!

Although she must somehow change the future where she will be executed, Louis, the very person responsible for her downfall, is now suddenly clinging to her...?!

A fantasy about a “ruthless” lady who upholds her code of honor with nothing but her fists begins!!
author: Etou Shiro
